**[P2] Preserve the synthetic root’s cross-invocation envelope**

This timestamp is re-anchored on every invocation and is later reused to end `DurableExecutionRoot`. In the added −60 s wall-step/resume case, the first `Invocation` ends on the original epoch while the terminal root ends on the adjusted epoch, placing that child after its parent. Retain the maximum emitted SDK boundary per execution and use a separately clamped timestamp for terminal Workflow/root spans; also assert that every invocation is contained by the synthetic root in the backward-step test.
